title: OpenDEA Assessment Indicator
description: An observable characteristic relevant to determining whether a Criterion has been met (CR-AM-05A §12). The Indicator separates the Question from what is actually being measured (§12). Example: 'Percentage of operational decisions automatically executed' — possible value 78%.

measure.description: The Measure through which this Indicator is observed (§13: Observation → Indicator/Measure → Criterion).

unit.description: Unit of the observed value (e.g. percent).
